message: Diagnostic Deck Active. Read this overview to understand how to handle system exceptions.
traceback:
WELCOME TO THE EXOSUIT COMPANION DIAGNOSTIC MATRIX
================================================================================

If you are viewing this layout panel, it means the Control Deck has successfully scanned
your local storage directories and verified that your reporting files are fully legible.

HOW TO ANALYZE AN EXOSUIT ANOMALY:
1. If an operational exception ever triggers during live gameplay monitoring, the application
   will generate a 12-character token code (e.g. DSV-XXXXXXXXXX) and log the details.
2. That token will immediately be listed right here inside your 'Recent Local Incident Events' dropdown menu.
3. Simply click the dropdown selector arrow above, choose the target event string, and the system will
   automatically execute a lookup, parse the traceback history, and expose the solution inline.

PRIVACY SAFETY MANDATE:
Your diagnostic reports are saved purely inside this localized file on your drive. They are NEVER
transmitted to a cloud server or uploaded automatically. If you open a GitHub support issue,
you can safely review, redact, and copy-paste these trace fields to assist with tracking bugs manually.

TARGET REPAIR PATHS DECK:
Notice that to your right, the Path Management interface has automatically loaded out in the open.
This is your active repair deck. If a token lookup points to a directory path error, you can modify
your system variables inline right here, click Apply, and correct the issue with zero tab hopping!
